premises.text: People at events and bars miss relevant nearby people while obsessing over distant digital contacts
premises.evidence_span: found yourself obsessively checking your texts, emails, and tweets sent by people thousands of miles away

premises.text: Sonar lists nearby venues and ranks people present by relevance using aggregated public profile data
premises.evidence_span: we give you a list of trending venues nearby. All it takes is one click to see how you're connected to everyone in that venue

premises.text: Shared friends, interests, and bios supply social proof for a one-click hyper-targeted meetup message
premises.evidence_span: Sonar sent a personal, hyper-targeted message to someone in this room with enough social proof to get the conversation started

premises.text: Hyperlocal self-expression lets users broadcast what they are about and looking for to people physically present
premises.evidence_span: a form of digital local self-expression that you can use to share what you're proud of and what you're looking for with the people here

value.text: Make the in-person connection you traveled for instead of leaving it to chance
value.evidence_span: Are you guys really going to leave that up to chance?
